audit.whatIsWrong: Purgatory is described only as an execute. It also GROUNDS — and nothing in the matchup says so, even though Skip 'n Slash is Gwen's only escape.
audit.why: Riot flags Purgatory with grounding and slow as well as execute. Grounded means Skip 'n Slash will not fire, so being inside the zone at low HP is not merely dangerous, it removes your exit. Separately, Soul Ignition heals back a portion of the self-damage at the END of its duration, which is the exact moment Grievous Wounds has to already be applied.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated in Key Ability Interactions, the level-6 spike and whys[5]; the Soul Ignition heal timing stated in the cooldown breakdown.
